content: Order status lifecycle (Adobe Commerce/Magento/industry docs): Pending (created, unpaid) -> Payment authorized/Confirmed -> Processing -> Shipped -> Delivered; terminal states: Canceled, Failed/Declined, Refunded/Closed. Order status covers financial+fulfillment; fulfillment status is logistics-only. For mock-payment demos, CREATED/PENDING_PAYMENT -> PAID | PAYMENT_FAILED | CANCELLED is an honest minimum; SHIPPED/DELIVERED require simulated transitions.
